nodes.name: Sklearn Spectral Biclustering Sparse Preprocessing Atoms
nodes.description: Sparse normalization helpers used before spectral biclustering SVD and KMeans stages

nodes.name: bicluster_sparse_scale_normalize
nodes.description: Shift sparse data to nonnegative values, then scale rows and columns independently for spectral biclustering.
nodes.type_signature: (X: sparse matrix) -> tuple[sparse matrix, NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64]]

nodes.name: bicluster_sparse_bistochastic_distance
nodes.description: Compute the sparse stopping distance used by sklearn's bistochastic normalization loop.
nodes.type_signature: (current: sparse matrix, original: sparse matrix) -> float

nodes.name: bicluster_sparse_bistochastic_normalize
nodes.description: Repeatedly apply sparse scale normalization until sklearn's sparse stopping distance is small.
nodes.type_signature: (X: sparse matrix, max_iter: int = 1000, tol: float = 1e-5) -> sparse matrix
